provenance: Shape from the schema line quoted in chat.html's handler — 'Every live background task after the change. REPLACE semantics: swap your set for this payload.' The REPLACE rule is the whole point of the fixture: merging would leave a finished task on the roster forever. STEPS 4-5 ADDED 2026-08-15: the CLI's own schema for this frame says the level is PER-PROCESS — "nothing is emitted at startup, so consumers must reset to the empty set whenever the session's CLI process (re)starts and let the next membership change repopulate it" (read verbatim from 2.1.233). The panel had that exactly inverted: sendTurn wiped the roster on every ordinary message, where a background shell survives by design, while clearLogUI — the __clear that ChatPanel pushes on new conversation / resume / CLI restart / delete-current, i.e. every actual process restart — left it populated. Found while investigating a user report of a '2 tasks' chip; the count turned out to be CORRECT (two orphaned waiter shells were genuinely alive), and this was the real defect underneath. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN against the pre-fix build: 5 assertions failed — 3 on the turn boundary and 2 on the restart. The restart step had to repopulate the roster inside itself: on the first attempt the previous step's sendTurn had already emptied it and the assertion passed for the wrong reason, which is the vacuous pass conventions.md warns about. STEPS 6-7 ADDED 2026-08-15 from a user report: hovering a roster row showed a DARK background and leaving the popup left it LIGHTER and stuck. Both halves measured: chat.css's .bg-row opt-out wins against .popup-item:hover (0,3,0 vs 0,2,0) so hover is correctly suppressed — the dark — but only TIES with .popup-item.sel (0,2,0 each) which is declared later and therefore wins on mouseout — the lighter. The .sel itself comes from a document-level mouseover painter that has no mouseout counterpart, plus tg()'s generic branch seeding row 0 on open. The roster is display-only, so it takes no cursor at all now. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN against the pre-fix build: the 3 roster assertions failed, the slash-menu GUARD passed in both phases.
